name: Availability
why: A request whose model step is unavailable still reaches a person, but every one costs an agent the time the draft would have saved. One in a hundred is the level the team agreed to absorb.

name: Latency
why: Drafts must be ready when an agent opens the queue. Two model calls at the live median of 2.4 s each leave room under 8 s for retries on a minority of requests.

name: Escalation share
why: The share of requests a person handles without a draft is the agents' workload. Above this, the assistant is not paying for itself; it is also the first place a change in the traffic mix shows.

name: Flagged drafts
why: A flagged draft promised something or stated a number the article does not contain; it still reaches a person, with the draft attached. Under the shipped prompts the checks flag 4 to 6 percent of drafts on ordinary weeks, most of them deferrals that name an outcome, so the target is set above that and a rising rate is the signal, not the level.

name: Spend
why: The POC charter's cost gate, at the operator-supplied rates. Without rates the objective reports insufficient data rather than a guess.
